name: target_weight_wacc_capped_shield_flotation
question_template: A firm computes WACC with target weights: debt is {WD} percent of capital, the rest common equity. The required equity return of {KE} percent is grossed up for a flotation cost of {FE} percent of gross proceeds: ke_f=KE/(1-FE/100). Debt of {D} USD million costs {KD} percent pretax with no flotation cost. Interest deductibility is capped at {CAP} percent of EBITDA of {EBITDA} USD million: interest I=D*KD/100, deductible interest is the lesser of I and the cap, and only that portion earns the shield at the {T} percent tax rate, so the after-tax debt cost is KD*(1-(T/100)*(deductible/I)). WACC applies the target weights to ke_f and this after-tax debt cost. Use exact arithmetic and do not round any intermediate value. What is the WACC in percent?

slots.description: Exact equity cost after grossing up for flotation costs.
Exact annual interest eligible for the tax shield after the EBITDA cap.
Exact pretax debt cost reduced by the capped effective tax shield.

program:
def solve():
    wd = Q(P["WD"]) / 100
    we = 1 - wd
    ke = Q(P["KE"])
    fe = Q(P["FE"]) / 100
    kd = Q(P["KD"])
    d = Q(P["D"])
    ebitda = Q(P["EBITDA"])
    cap_rate = Q(P["CAP"]) / 100
    t = Q(P["T"]) / 100
    ke_f = ke / (1 - fe)
    interest = d * kd / 100
    cap = cap_rate * ebitda
    deductible = interest if interest < cap else cap
    kd_at = kd * (1 - t * (deductible / interest))
    wacc = we * ke_f + wd * kd_at
    return {
        "final": wacc,
        "flotation_adjusted_equity_cost_percent": ke_f,
        "deductible_interest": deductible,
        "after_tax_debt_cost_percent": kd_at,
    }
